answer.worked: Add the marbles won and subtract those lost: $12+3-5=10$ marbles.
Add the marbles won and subtract those lost: $x+y-z$ marbles.
Subtract those who have a sister from the class total: $30-10=20$ children.
Subtract those who have a sister from the class total: $a-b$ children.
Subtract the correct answers from the total: $30-25=5$ questions.
Subtract the correct answers from the total: $x-y$ questions.
Number of bars × cost per bar: $7\times3=21$ dollars.
Number of bars × cost per bar: $a\times b=ab$ dollars.
Multiply Maddie’s number of cards by 2: $5\times2=10$ cards.
Multiply Maddie’s number of cards by the multiplier: $a\times b=ab$ cards.
